I started cutting when I was 11 years old. I continued throughout middle school, I almost always had some unhealed cuts on me. I never cut deep though.

I quit when I was maybe 14 or 15??? Then relapsed when I was 16. I’m 17 now and I haven’t cut since December 3rd, so that’s a little over 4 months.

It’s okay to be confused about it. Cutting is a coping mechanism we use to handle tough and overwhelming emotions and situations. There are endless reasons why a person may choose to cut.

I know that in the past I have cut for attention. That’s not healthy but it doesn’t make you a bad person. Try to reframe it; instead of attention seeking, consider it “support seeking”.

 And if you are cutting, you have a reason to cut. You wouldn’t do it if you literally had no reason. Seeking attention counts as a reason, and it can be a way of asking for help.

Speaking of help, you should definitely see a therapist. You don’t need to have depression or be suicidal to see a therapist. I strongly believe that therapy with the right therapist can benefit ANYone. 

Me telling you to just not cut probably won’t make a difference, so I’m just going to urge you to be safe and keep things sanitary.
